name: B10-0127/2024 (PfE) – Urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to rewrite two laws on medical devices: one for regular devices and one for lab tests used to diagnose illness. The Parliament says the current rules are complex and costly, and that this puts the availability and affordability of medical devices for patients at risk. It wants a simpler, more predictable system that still keeps patients safe. This is only a request; it does not change any law itself.

- The Parliament asks the Commission to propose revising both medical device laws.
- Manufacturers, especially small and medium-sized firms, and patients would be affected.
- Next, the Commission decides whether to put forward a proposal.
